text: The applicant has applied to the Committee of Adjustment (Application A0209/18NY) for minor variances from Zoning By-laws 7625 and 569-2013 in order to permit the construction of a one-storey rear-addition to the existing home (the "Application"). The variances sought include for: east side yard setback; rear yard setback; building length; and lot coverage. In a staff report dated May 7, 2018, City Planning Staff expressed concern with the variances for proposed lot coverage and building length. The lot coverage of the existing dwelling already exceeds the standard lot coverage for dwellings in the vicinity and the proposed addition would further exaggerate a condition that is not typical of the neighbourhood.
